اضطربن (form VIII)
# اِضْطَرَبْنَ (iḍṭarabna) /idˤ.tˤa.rab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# اِضْطَرِبْنَ (iḍṭaribna) /idˤ.tˤa.rib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
